description: Search The Flowers Directory catalog of fresh flower arrangements and plants for US florist delivery, by occasion (birthday, sympathy/funeral, get well, anniversary, romance, new baby, thank you and more), color, flower type, arrangement type (vase, basket, standing spray, wreath, casket spray and more), size, budget and free text. Every result includes the product code used by the other tools, the arrangement price, a photo URL, total_before_tax (price plus the flat $19.99 delivery fee) and, when known, structured attributes: arrangement type, size tier, height and width in inches, stem count, container and who it suits (sender_fit). Returns up to 20 matches, best match first.

arrangement_type.description: One of: vase_arrangement, basket, floor_basket, table_arrangement, centerpiece, plant, dish_garden, wreath, standing_spray, standing_heart, standing_cross, casket_spray, casket_adornment, urn_tribute. Common words like "vase", "spray", "easel", "casket" or "urn" are accepted.

budget.description: Maximum all-in amount in USD before tax (arrangement price + $19.99 delivery). Use this for "around $110"-style requests.

colors.description: Colors that should appear in the arrangement (any match). Known values: red, pink, white, yellow, purple, lavender, orange, blue, green, cream, peach, coral, burgundy, gold, mixed.

flower_types.description: Flower types that should appear (any match). Known values: roses, lilies, tulips, sunflowers, orchids, carnations, daisies, hydrangeas, alstroemeria, chrysanthemums, gerberas, lisianthus, snapdragons, dahlias, peonies, irises, delphinium, larkspur, gladiolus, calla lilies, freesia, ranunculus, asters, proteas, anthuriums, succulents, stock, poinsettia, plants, mixed.

occasion.description: One of: sympathy, birthday, romance, anniversary, get_well, new_baby, thank_you, mothers_day, congratulations, wedding, just_because. "funeral" is accepted as sympathy.

query.description: Free-text keywords matched against the title and description, e.g. "blue hydrangea in a vase" or "standing spray".

size.description: One of: small (under 14 in), medium (14 to 22 in), large (over 22 in), tribute (easel, casket and floor pieces for funerals).

name: search_arrangements
title: Search flower arrangements
